CaseSensitivity.description:
Whether a root's filesystem distinguishes names differing only in case.

Recorded per root rather than assumed globally, because one project can span
a case-sensitive volume and a case-insensitive one and the same name means
different things on each.
CaseSensitivity.title: CaseSensitivity

description:
One indexed root of a data pool.

The logical identifier is separate from the mount path, so a project survives relocation.
Moving a data pool changes ``mount_path`` and leaves every entry identifier untouched.
title: Root
